pr.title: feat(adhd): native_hooks -> engine activity ingress (always-on signal)
pr.body: Gives the default-started ADHD engine its first always-on real signal source: PostToolUse hook -> fail-open POST to the engine /external-activity ingress (C2).

steps.task: Add a POST /external-activity ingress on the engine.
validation: services/adhd_engine/api/routes.py exposes POST /external-activity accepting {event_type, tool_name, ts}.
native_hooks.py:479-535 fires a fail-open POST reusing the existing client pattern; never blocks or raises on engine-down.
Hook test asserts POST attempted and no exception when engine is unreachable.
engine /api/v1/state shifts in response to real tool activity.
